title: Connecticut College (ConnCollege)
summary: Connecticut College (ConnCollege) is a university in New London. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with ConnCollege.

sections.heading: What ConnCollege is known for
paragraphs: Connecticut College (ConnCollege) is a private nonprofit institution known for its commitment to providing a comprehensive liberal arts education. With an undergraduate enrollment of approximately 1,937 students, the college offers a diverse academic environment. ConnCollege maintains a selective admission process, with an admission rate of about 37.04%, reflecting its competitive nature. While the college does not have programs specifically focused on health or business fields, it emphasizes a broad-based curriculum designed to foster critical thinking and interdisciplinary learning. As a private nonprofit college, ConnCollege is dedicated to supporting student success through a variety of academic and extracurricular opportunities.

sections.heading: How to read ConnCollege tuition
paragraphs: Connecticut College (ConnCollege) charges a tuition fee of $67,242 for both in-state and out-of-state students, reflecting a uniform tuition policy regardless of residency. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as room, board, fees, and other related costs, amounts to $84,623. When evaluating ConnCollege tuition, it is important to consider this comprehensive figure to understand the full financial commitment required for enrollment.

sections.heading: Financial aid
paragraphs: Connecticut College (ConnCollege) offers financial aid to support students in managing the cost of attendance. Prospective students and families can explore detailed financial aid information and use the net price calculator available on the college's official website at www.conncoll.edu/.
